name: audit_goals
description: Audit goals against recent git commits, detecting implemented goals with commit SHAs, and optionally auto-syncing goals/README.md.

project.description: Optional project ID or workspace root directory

name: compile_rules
description: Compile the latest project handoff, architectural memos, verified facts, and reference docs into agent rule files (CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, AGENTS.md, .windsurfrules).

project.description: Project ID or directory slug

target.description: Target format: claude (default), cursor, windsurf, agents

name: diagnose_system
description: Run end-to-end system diagnostic health audit on SQLite DB integrity, FTS5 virtual indexes, project path existence on disk, and storage permissions, with optional automatic repair.

repair.description: If true, automatically rebuilds FTS5 indexes and optimizes query planner

name: get_db_stats
description: Get detailed SQLite database storage statistics, including file size, page count, freelist pages, and fragmentation percentage.

name: get_doc
description: Retrieve the full text and metadata of a specific attached document by ID.

name: get_latest_handoff
description: Retrieve the most recent active session handoff for a project.

project.description: Project ID or directory slug

name: get_message_context
description: Retrieve surrounding chronological context turns (before and after) for a specific conversation message ID, expanding verbatim context on demand without polluting the whole context window.

window.description: Number of preceding and following turns to retrieve (default 3, max 20)

name: get_package_doc
description: Fetch official package and registry documentation for Go (pkg.go.dev), Rust (crates.io/docs.rs), NPM (npmjs.org), or Python (pypi.org) and optionally auto-ingest into project memory.

auto_save.description: If true, saves package doc into project knowledge store

ecosystem.description: Registry ecosystem: auto (default), go, rust, npm, python

project.description: Project ID to attach doc to

name: get_project_facts
description: Retrieve all distilled claims/facts for a specific project with pagination support.

facts_only.description: Filter by promoted, LLM-distilled facts only

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default all)

project.description: Project ID (e.g. sila)

refs_exist_only.description: Filter by claims whose referenced files exist on disk

name: get_status
description: Get knowledge store health statistics and summary counts.

name: list_feedback
description: Retrieve recorded agent feedback, suggestions, issues, and tips across projects for periodic review.

category.description: Optional category filter: idea, issue, tip, challenge, praise

project.description: Optional project ID filter

name: list_goals
description: List all goal packages in the project's goals/ directory, including titles, descriptions, implementation statuses, and /goal launch commands.

pending_only.description: If true, only return pending/ready-to-execute goals

project.description: Optional project ID or workspace root directory

name: list_projects
description: List all indexed project repositories with message, claim, and file_refs_exist counts.

name: omni_search
description: Unified multi-source hybrid search querying Architectural Invariants, Distilled Code Claims, Raw Message Transcripts, Git Commits, and External Docs in a single blended, ranked query.

project.description: Optional project selector to scope search

name: prime_context
description: Retrieve an active session briefing (latest handoff, open tasks, key architectural facts, and disk grounding) for priming an agent at session start.

max_facts.description: Maximum number of key facts to include (default 5)

project.description: Optional project ID or directory slug

name: reconcile_drift
description: Audit filesystem drift by re-verifying whether referenced repository files exist on disk for stored claims.

project.description: Optional project ID or directory slug (empty to reconcile all projects)

name: record_feedback
description: Submit agent observations, recommendations, issues faced, tips, friction/challenges, or praise to help continuously improve sila.

category.description: Feedback category: idea, issue, tip, challenge, praise (default: idea)

content.description: Feedback content, recommendation, challenge, or message

project.description: Optional project ID or repository name

name: save_doc
description: Save or attach an external reference document, API guide, or markdown documentation to a project.

content.description: Markdown or text content of the document

project.description: Project ID or directory name

url.description: Optional source URL or file path

name: save_handoff
description: Save a structured session handoff record (summary, open tasks, decisions, branch) to pass the baton cleanly to the next agent session.

agent.description: Agent or tool identifier (e.g. claude-code, devin)

open_items.description: List of open tasks and pending items

project.description: Project ID or directory name

repo_files.description: Key repository files touched or referenced

summary.description: Summary of work completed and current state

name: save_memo
description: Record an explicit architectural directive, decision, or project memo directly into the verified knowledge store.

project.description: Project ID or directory name

name: search_code
description: Search open-source code across public repositories on GitHub and optionally auto-ingest resulting code files into the project store.

auto_save.description: If true, fetches full raw source files and saves into project memory

project.description: Project ID to attach code docs to

query.description: Code search terms or syntax (e.g. 'sqlite fts5 tokenizer')

name: search_docs
description: Search attached external reference documents and API guides for a project using SQLite FTS5 full-text search.

project.description: Optional project ID or directory slug

name: search_knowledge
description: Search distilled knowledge, claims, and architectural decisions across AI CLI sessions using SQLite FTS5 full-text search.

facts_only.description: If true, only return promoted, LLM-distilled verified facts

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10)

project.description: Optional project id or dir filter

refs_exist_only.description: If true, only return claims whose referenced repo files exist on disk

tool.description: Optional tool filter (devin, mimocode, opencode, codex, command-code, agy)

name: search_messages
description: Search raw conversation transcripts and message history across all AI CLI tools using SQLite FTS5 full-text search.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10)

project.description: Optional project id or dir filter

since.description: Optional timestamp filter in RFC3339 format

tool.description: Optional tool filter (devin, mimocode, opencode, codex, etc.)

name: search_stackoverflow
description: Search developer QA, troubleshooting threads, and error resolutions on Stack Overflow and optionally auto-ingest solutions into project memory.

auto_save.description: If true, saves troubleshooting thread into project knowledge store

project.description: Project ID to attach solutions to

name: search_web_docs
description: Search live online documentation using Google Custom Search and optionally auto-ingest resulting documentation pages into the project store.

auto_save.description: If true, fetches and saves full Markdown content for top results

project.description: Project ID to attach documents to

name: vacuum_database
description: Run SQLite VACUUM and optimize query planner statistics on the knowledge store, defragmenting storage and reclaiming disk space.

force.description: If true, forces a full vacuum even if freelist fragmentation is low
